description: This PHP source file defines the ApiProvider class within the Aws\Api namespace. It provides methods for resolving, loading, and managing API data for AWS services, including handling API version manifests and directory-based model loading.

classes.name: ApiProvider
classes.description: Provides static and instance methods for resolving, loading, and managing AWS API data, including handling API version manifests and directory-based models.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an API provider call with specified type, service, and version, returning API data or throwing an exception if unresolved.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns a default ApiProvider instance with pre-built manifest data.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Creates an ApiProvider instance with a given directory and manifest data.

methods.name: filesystem
methods.description: Creates an ApiProvider instance that loads API data from a specified directory.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of valid API versions for a given service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the provider to load API data for a specific type, service, and version.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ApiProvider with a models directory and optional manifest.

methods.name: buildVersionsList
methods.description: Builds a list of available API versions for a service by scanning the directory.
